title: Dropping new game ideas here weekly where I'm focused on finding the fun. Week 4: Just Another Tuesday
author: StaticAnchor
selftext:
Hey everyone!

Back with another game idea I found to be pretty fun.

The basis for this game was thinking about a new take on survivorlikes. I haven't seen anyone attempt anything like this, but the core visual I build this around was..wouldn't it be hilarious to ram into a zombie at full speed and watch it ragdoll into the sky.

I couldn't stop laughing and how satisfying it felt. Maybe I should talk to someone about that.

I build a prototype around it. Different ways to upgrade your car, and just kept leaning into the ridiculousness of it all. I kept finding new secrets to add into the game, different things you could do and unlock. Added some characters, and took inspiration from games like Doom and StarFox

To be honest, AI has been a blessing and a curse in this regard. Being able to add as much as you can think of turns out to not always be the best thing. I've been finding new ways to slow down and use AI more intentionally in my workflow, to really polish up what makes your hook "fun".

I have is hosted on itch, would love any feedback on it, or any of the other games I've dropped here over the past few weeks.

Thanks!

[Demo for Just Another Tuesday](https://hookandloopgames.itch.io/just-another-tuesday)
